caseName: Hastings v. Committee on the Judiciary of the United States House of Representatives
caseNameFull: Hastings, Judge, United States District Court for the Southern District of Florida v. Committee on the Judiciary of the United States House of Representatives

opinions.text:
C. A. 11th Cir. Application to continue the stay of mandate, presented to Justice Kennedy, and by him referred to the Court, denied.

The Chief Justice took no part in the consideration or decision of this application.
